fields.claim: The dent model (face membrane plus core crush over a plastic spread) is this seat's. It reads Pach's test within its 1.1-1.2 mm and 30 mm, and Clarke's FE at about half the FE depth. Hail is read three ways (fluid, Shi-calibrated, all energy) that span ten times in depth.
fields.needed_to_ground: Ice-ball tests on a beryllium-faced CR-III panel at 25-75 mm and IEC velocities.
